findings.note: New England has ruled out guards Vera-Tucker and Brown plus CBs Davis, Prunty and Canada, with RT Moses questionable. Walter Rouse and Matt Pryor will start at guard, and rookie Lomu could make his first start at RT if Moses can't play.
Bears RB Kyle Monangai is out for a third straight game. Chicago has been held under 100 rushing yards in consecutive games without him, and its yards per play fell from 6.8 to 4.7.

Bears RG Jonah Jackson has no injury designation and is set to play. LB T.J. Edwards is doubtful and expected to miss a second straight game, LB Sanborn is out, and Walter Rouse would be making his first NFL start for New England.
